bands.summary_en: Handle immediate needs with familiar words, short sentences and predictable exchanges.
bands.summary_ru: Простые фразы и короткие диалоги для повседневных ситуаций.

bands.summary_en: Manage everyday transactions, describe routines and link simple events.
bands.summary_ru: Повседневные задачи, описание привычек и простая последовательность событий.

bands.summary_en: Explain experiences and reasons, resolve familiar problems and follow connected accounts.
bands.summary_ru: Связные рассказы, объяснение причин и решение знакомых задач.

bands.summary_en: Develop an argument, compare alternatives and handle less predictable exchanges.
bands.summary_ru: Развёрнутые аргументы, сравнение вариантов и менее предсказуемые диалоги.

bands.summary_en: Interpret complex material and communicate precisely across specialist, cultural and abstract topics.
bands.summary_ru: Сложные тексты, точное выражение мысли и обсуждение специальных и абстрактных тем.

generation_guidance: Use short concrete sentences and a predictable everyday situation. Introduce one new demand at a time.
Use the selected topic’s target words and taught patterns. Supply enough context to understand a small number of new words.
Practise basic present tense, familiar past forms where needed, and frequent case patterns in meaningful sentences.
Avoid unexplained participles, idioms, dense clauses or a requirement to master an entire paradigm.
Make the task achievable through a short phrase or simple sentence. Keep questions concrete and answerable from the material.
Use connected everyday language about familiar people, plans, transactions and recent events.
Practise past and future, common case government, comparisons and an introductory aspect or motion contrast in context.
Include a simple change of plan, clarification or reason. Keep the communicative goal clear.
Introduce unfamiliar words through the situation and avoid unsupported specialist knowledge.
Expect short connected answers; do not demand advanced terminology or literary interpretation.
Use a connected account or realistic problem with reasons, consequences and a modest complication.
Require understanding beyond one matching word: sequence, motive, contrast or a supported inference.
Practise productive case government, aspect in narration, motion verbs, reported speech and common subordinate clauses.
Ask for explanation, comparison or an achievable solution. Accept clear simpler constructions when they fulfil the task.
Use topic vocabulary in context and introduce useful additional words rather than restricting output to the saved list.
Create a substantive situation with competing needs, a supported argument or an implicit but recoverable viewpoint.
Use varied sentence structure, natural aspect choices and appropriate register. Include participles or adverbial participles only where natural.
Ask learners to justify a choice, qualify a claim or respond to a counterargument.
Preserve clear agency, conditions and factual uncertainty. Do not substitute obscure vocabulary for intellectual demand.
Provide the contextual facts needed for the task; success must not depend on specialist prior knowledge.
Use sustained, natural Russian with implicit connections, register choices and competing interpretations.
Ask for synthesis, precise explanation or a well-supported argument within the selected advanced topic.
Use complex syntax, lexical collocations and idiomatic wording purposefully, with enough context for interpretation.
Require careful attribution, qualification and organisation. Do not equate advanced ability with long or obscure sentences.
Use invented factual material when a scenario needs evidence that has not been supplied; make its fictional status clear.
Use the same advanced topic sequence with finer distinctions of implication, stance, register and pragmatic intent.
Ask learners to reconcile conflicting readings, reformulate for a different audience or defend a precise distinction.
Include ambiguity only when the context supports discussion of more than one interpretation; never hide an arbitrary expected answer.
Assess precision, flexibility and fidelity to meaning rather than inflated length, jargon or a single preferred phrasing.
Keep source claims and invented scenarios distinguishable; do not invent quotations or real-world authority.

objectives: Greet someone and say goodbye politely.
Introduce yourself and ask someone their name.
grammar_focus: Personal pronouns in short introductions: Я Анна.
Learn the fixed accusative patterns Меня зовут… and Как вас зовут?
Distinguish informal ты from polite вы.

practice.reading: A new neighbour introduces herself. Ask who she is and how the speakers greet one another.
practice.writing: Write a greeting and a short introduction for a new classmate.
practice.translation: Translate short greetings and introductions, choosing ты or вы from the stated relationship.
practice.word_jumble: Combine greeting words and a name into one plausible introduction.
practice.speaking: Meet a new classmate, exchange names and say goodbye.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Поздоровайтесь и представьтесь, используя предложенные слова и имя.

objectives: Recognise numbers from one to ten.
Say when a simple daily event happens.
grammar_focus: Practise taught clock patterns: один час, два часа, пять часов.
Use утром and вечером as time expressions.
Distinguish a time from a duration in simple examples: в два часа; два часа.

practice.reading: Use a short timetable for a learner’s day. Ask when two events start.
practice.writing: Write three entries in a simple daily timetable.
practice.translation: Translate times and short arrangements using familiar clock phrases.
practice.word_jumble: Use a small set of time words to arrange a meeting.
practice.speaking: Agree on a time to meet and confirm the number of people.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Договоритесь о встрече, используя слова для обозначения времени.

objectives: Name close family members and friends.
Describe who is in your family.
grammar_focus: Use мой, моя and мои with familiar family nouns.
Introduce someone with Это… and a nominative noun.
Learn У меня есть… as the basic possession pattern.

practice.reading: Read a short family introduction. Ask who is related to whom.
practice.writing: Introduce three family members or invented characters.
practice.translation: Translate short descriptions of family relationships and possession.
practice.word_jumble: Use family nouns and possessives to introduce someone.
practice.speaking: Show a family photograph and answer simple questions about the people.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Представьте кого-нибудь, используя названия членов семьи и притяжательные местоимения.

objectives: Name common rooms and furniture.
Say where a familiar object is.
grammar_focus: Use в or на with taught prepositional forms: в комнате, на столе.
Contrast singular and plural in familiar nouns: окно — окна.
Use simple adjective agreement: большой дом, большая комната.

practice.reading: Describe a small flat and the location of three objects. Ask which room contains each object.
practice.writing: Write a short description of one room.
practice.translation: Translate simple statements about where furniture and objects are.
practice.word_jumble: Build a sentence placing one object in a room.
practice.speaking: Help a visitor find an object in your home.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение о том, где в комнате находится предмет.

objectives: Name common foods and drinks.
Ask for something to eat or drink.
grammar_focus: Use хочу with a noun or infinitive: хочу суп; хочу пить.
Practise singular accusative objects: ем рыбу, пью воду.
Learn a polite request pattern with можно.

practice.reading: A person chooses a simple breakfast. Ask what they eat and drink.
practice.writing: Write what you would like for breakfast.
practice.translation: Translate short food requests with a clear eater, drinker or customer.
practice.word_jumble: Use food words to make a complete request or statement.
practice.speaking: Ask for a drink and one item of food.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте просьбу или предложение с названиями продуктов и напитков.

objectives: Describe a few activities in your usual day.
Ask what someone is doing now.
grammar_focus: Use present-tense forms of common first- and second-conjugation verbs.
Learn frequent irregular forms in context: ем, сплю, иду.
Use simple time words with a subject and verb.

practice.reading: Read a short account of an ordinary day. Ask who does each activity and when.
practice.writing: Describe your morning in short linked sentences.
practice.translation: Translate present-tense statements and questions about everyday activities.
practice.word_jumble: Combine a person, an activity and a time expression.
practice.speaking: Compare what you and a friend are doing today.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение о том, кто, что и когда делает.

objectives: Identify an object by colour and size.
Give a short description of a familiar object.
grammar_focus: Match adjectives to noun gender: красный стол, красная сумка, красное яблоко.
Use plural adjectives with familiar plural nouns: новые книги.
Use этот, эта and это to identify an object.

practice.reading: Describe similar objects that differ in colour or size. Ask which object a person needs.
practice.writing: Describe two objects so another person can tell them apart.
practice.translation: Translate object descriptions with consistent adjective agreement.
practice.word_jumble: Build an identifying phrase and a complete sentence from colour and object words.
practice.speaking: Choose an object by explaining its colour and size.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Опишите предмет и составьте о нём предложение, указав его цвет или размер.

objectives: Name common items of clothing.
Identify clothing by colour and size.
grammar_focus: Treat штаны as a plural-only noun and пальто as indeclinable.
Use familiar accusative forms after носить: ношу шапку.
Match adjectives to clothing nouns: синяя куртка, синие штаны.

practice.reading: A person packs clothes for one day. Ask what they take and which item is described.
practice.writing: Describe a simple outfit using colours.
practice.translation: Translate short clothing descriptions and requests.
practice.word_jumble: Use an item of clothing and an adjective in a complete sentence.
practice.speaking: Ask a shop assistant for an item in a particular colour.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение с названием предмета одежды и прилагательным.

objectives: Ask where a familiar place is.
Follow a short direction using a visible landmark.
grammar_focus: Distinguish location где from direction куда in simple examples.
Learn common direction commands as useful forms: идите, поверните.
Use в and на with taught place expressions: в парке, на улице.

practice.reading: Give a short route with one turn and a named destination. Ask which way to go.
practice.writing: Write two simple directions to a familiar place.
practice.translation: Translate brief directions whose starting point and destination are explicit.
practice.word_jumble: Build a direction containing a place and a direction word.
practice.speaking: Ask for a nearby place, repeat the direction and thank the speaker.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Объясните, куда идти, указав место и направление.

objectives: Describe the weather today.
Choose simple clothing or plans for the weather.
grammar_focus: Use impersonal weather statements: холодно, тепло, жарко.
Distinguish a noun or adjective from a state word: холод; холодный; холодно.
Use present weather patterns: идёт дождь, светит солнце.

practice.reading: Read a simple forecast for two days. Ask which day suits a proposed activity.
practice.writing: Write a short weather message to a friend.
practice.translation: Translate short weather statements without inventing a grammatical subject.
practice.word_jumble: Combine weather and time words in a sentence.
practice.speaking: Ask about the weather and agree on a simple plan.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение о погоде, указав время.

objectives: Ask about a price, size or available item.
Complete a purchase and explain a simple problem.
grammar_focus: Use стоить with taught number-and-ruble patterns.
Contrast buying as a process and a completed purchase: покупать — купить.
Use dative experiencers in needs: мне нужен чек, мне нужна сумка.

practice.reading: A customer compares two items and buys one. Ask about the choice, price and problem.
practice.writing: Write a short message asking a shop about an item.
practice.translation: Translate a short purchase exchange with prices and a polite request.
practice.word_jumble: Use shopping words to explain a choice or purchase.
practice.speaking: Buy an item, ask about another size and check the change.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Объясните свой выбор или расскажите о покупке, используя предложенные слова.

objectives: Ask about departure, destination and a simple connection.
Describe a recent or planned journey.
grammar_focus: Contrast ехать for a particular trip with ездить for repeated travel.
Use в or на plus accusative for destination and prepositional for location.
Use на plus prepositional for transport: на автобусе.

practice.reading: A journey includes one connection. Ask where, when and how the traveller changes transport.
practice.writing: Write a short travel plan with a departure time and destination.
practice.translation: Translate travel arrangements with explicit transport and direction.
practice.word_jumble: Build a travel sentence using a motion verb and destination.
practice.speaking: Buy a ticket and ask where to change trains.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение о поездке, указав направление и используя глагол движения.

objectives: Order a meal and state a simple preference.
Ask about ingredients or correct a mistaken order.
grammar_focus: Use polite imperatives and можно with an infinitive.
Use без plus genitive for ingredients: без сахара.
Practise accusative objects and simple quantity phrases when ordering.

practice.reading: A group places an order and changes one item. Ask what each person finally receives.
practice.writing: Write a short food order with one preference or restriction.
practice.translation: Translate a restaurant exchange that includes a request and clarification.
practice.word_jumble: Use restaurant words to ask for or describe an order.
practice.speaking: Order food for two people, clarify an ingredient and ask for the bill.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Попросите что-нибудь принести или расскажите о заказе в ресторане.

objectives: Say where you have pain and describe simple symptoms.
Ask how someone feels and understand basic advice.
grammar_focus: Match болит or болят to the painful body part.
Use dative experiencers: мне холодно, ему плохо.
Use нужно and нельзя with an infinitive for simple advice.

practice.reading: A person explains why they cannot attend a lesson. Ask about symptoms and the next step.
practice.writing: Write a short message explaining that you feel unwell.
practice.translation: Translate simple descriptions of symptoms and requests for help.
practice.word_jumble: Build a sentence describing a symptom or current feeling.
practice.speaking: Describe a minor fictional illness and answer simple follow-up questions.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение о симптоме или самочувствии.

objectives: Ask for an explanation or repetition during a lesson.
Describe school subjects and a homework task.
grammar_focus: Distinguish учить a subject from учиться somewhere.
Use dative recipients with explaining and giving: объяснить ученику.
Connect simple reasons with потому что.

practice.reading: A pupil checks homework instructions. Ask what must be done and what remains unclear.
practice.writing: Write a short message to a teacher about a task.
practice.translation: Translate lesson requests, questions and simple explanations.
practice.word_jumble: Use school words to explain a homework task or ask for help.
practice.speaking: Ask a teacher to explain a task and confirm what you need to do.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Объясните домашнее задание или попросите помощи, используя предложенные слова.

objectives: Describe a hobby and how often you do it.
Invite someone to an activity and respond to an invitation.
grammar_focus: Use нравиться with a dative experiencer: мне нравится музыка.
Contrast играть в a game with играть на an instrument.
Use любить with an infinitive and simple frequency phrases.

practice.reading: Two friends plan their weekend around different hobbies. Ask what they agree to do.
practice.writing: Write about a hobby and invite a friend to join you.
practice.translation: Translate preferences and invitations with correct verb patterns.
practice.word_jumble: Build a sentence explaining a hobby or preference.
practice.speaking: Compare hobbies and arrange an activity for the weekend.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение о своём увлечении или предпочтении.

objectives: Describe an animal and its daily care.
Explain where an animal lives and what it does.
grammar_focus: Practise animate accusative objects: вижу собаку, вижу медведя.
Use с plus instrumental for companionship: с собакой.
Use possessives and body-part nouns in short descriptions.

practice.reading: A neighbour leaves instructions for caring for a pet. Ask when to feed or walk it.
practice.writing: Write short care instructions for a pet.
practice.translation: Translate descriptions and care routines for familiar animals.
practice.word_jumble: Use animal words to describe an action or appearance.
practice.speaking: Explain how to look after your pet while you are away.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Опишите внешность животного или его действия.

objectives: Describe a simple natural landscape.
Explain where to go on a short outdoor trip.
grammar_focus: Use prepositions with familiar location patterns: у реки, рядом с лесом.
Practise comparative adjectives: выше, глубже.
Distinguish location and destination with в or на in a clear context.

practice.reading: Describe a walk past two natural features. Ask where the walkers stop and why.
practice.writing: Describe a place outdoors that you like.
practice.translation: Translate landscape descriptions and simple outdoor plans.
practice.word_jumble: Build a sentence locating one natural feature relative to another.
practice.speaking: Choose a place for a walk and explain what can be seen there.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Объясните, где находится один природный объект по отношению к другому.

objectives: Say what someone does for work.
Describe a simple workday and common responsibilities.
grammar_focus: Use instrumental professions after работать: работать врачом.
Use present and past tense to describe work routines and changes.
Practise verb-object patterns: водить автобус, помогать людям.

practice.reading: Introduce two people with different jobs. Ask what each person does and where they work.
practice.writing: Describe a real or invented person’s job.
practice.translation: Translate short statements about jobs and workplace routines.
practice.word_jumble: Use occupation words to describe a person and their work.
practice.speaking: Introduce your job and ask someone about their workday.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Расскажите о человеке и его работе, используя названия профессий.

objectives: Invite someone to a celebration and congratulate them.
Describe a recent celebration and exchanged gifts.
grammar_focus: Use dative recipients for gifts (подарить другу) and accusative plus с with instrumental for congratulations (поздравить друга с праздником).
Use past-tense gender and number in an account of a celebration.
Learn event names as phrases: день рождения, Новый год.

practice.reading: A short invitation and follow-up describe a birthday. Ask who attended and what happened.
practice.writing: Write an invitation or a short birthday message.
practice.translation: Translate congratulations, invitations and a simple account of a celebration.
practice.word_jumble: Use celebration words to describe giving a gift or inviting a guest.
practice.speaking: Invite a friend, agree on a time and discuss what to bring.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Расскажите о подарке или приглашении на праздник.

objectives: Explain a routine service request and supply the needed details.
Resolve a problem with an appointment, document or delivery.
grammar_focus: Choose aspect for a service process and its result: отправлять — отправить.
Use purpose clauses with чтобы: пришёл, чтобы получить справку.
Use case patterns after к, в, из and с when explaining a route between offices.

practice.reading: A resident visits two offices to resolve a delivery problem. Ask what prevented completion and what solved it.
practice.writing: Write a clear request to a local service, including the problem and desired result.
practice.translation: Translate a connected exchange about a service problem and the next steps.
practice.word_jumble: Use service-related words to explain a problem and a proposed solution.
practice.speaking: Report an undelivered parcel, clarify the address and agree on collection.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Объясните проблему при обращении в городскую службу и предложите решение.

objectives: Describe a familiar device problem in sequence.
Understand and give practical instructions.
grammar_focus: Use paired commands to describe a procedure: включите, проверьте, сохраните.
Distinguish reflexive and transitive uses: подключаться — подключать.
Use если and когда for conditions and sequence.

practice.reading: A troubleshooting note explains a device failure and repair. Ask which step addresses which symptom.
practice.writing: Write a short support request with the steps already tried.
practice.translation: Translate instructions and problem descriptions with clear sequence and result.
practice.word_jumble: Build a sentence describing a technical problem and a condition for fixing it.
practice.speaking: Explain why your device cannot connect and follow support instructions.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Опишите техническую проблему и условие, при котором её можно решить.

objectives: Describe a local environmental problem and its effects.
Suggest practical action and explain a reason.
grammar_focus: Connect causes and consequences with потому что, поэтому and из-за.
Use нужно, следует and можно for advice with different force.
Use comparative structures to compare practical options.

practice.reading: A neighbourhood changes its waste collection. Ask about the problem, reasons and proposed solution.
practice.writing: Write a proposal for one practical environmental improvement.
practice.translation: Translate advice and explanations about everyday environmental choices.
practice.word_jumble: Use environmental vocabulary in a cause-and-effect sentence.
practice.speaking: Discuss a local problem and agree on an achievable change.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение об экологической проблеме, связав причину и следствие.

objectives: Describe a match or sporting event in order.
Explain training plans, preferences and results.
grammar_focus: Use aspect to distinguish training habits from completed achievements.
Use comparative adjectives and adverbs: быстрее, сильнее.
Use verb-preposition patterns: участвовать в, болеть за.

practice.reading: A match report describes a turning point. Ask how the result changed and why.
practice.writing: Write an account of a real or invented sporting event.
practice.translation: Translate connected descriptions of training, competition and results.
practice.word_jumble: Use sports words to explain a result or training goal.
practice.speaking: Compare two sports and agree on a training plan with a friend.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Объясните результат соревнования или цель тренировки.

objectives: Describe an artistic event and your response.
Compare works or performances and explain a preference.
grammar_focus: Use relative clauses with который to identify a work or performer.
Contrast идти with сходить in plans and completed visits.
Give supported opinions with мне кажется and я считаю, что.

practice.reading: Two short reviews disagree about a performance. Ask what each reviewer liked and why.
practice.writing: Write a brief review with one specific observation.
practice.translation: Translate opinions about a concert, exhibition or performance.
practice.word_jumble: Build a sentence linking an artistic detail to an impression.
practice.speaking: Choose an event with a friend and explain your preferences.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение о том, как конкретная деталь произведения повлияла на ваше впечатление.

objectives: Explain how you feel and what caused the feeling.
Respond to another person with support or reassurance.
grammar_focus: Use governed cases: радоваться чему, бояться чего, сердиться на кого.
Describe changes with стало plus a state word: стало грустно.
Use conditional advice with бы in familiar patterns.

practice.reading: A character faces a setback and receives support. Ask how their feelings change and what helps.
practice.writing: Write a supportive reply to a friend explaining a difficult day.
practice.translation: Translate feelings and their causes while preserving who experiences them.
practice.word_jumble: Use emotion words in a sentence that explains a cause.
practice.speaking: Listen to a friend’s problem, ask a follow-up question and offer support.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение, объясняющее причину чувства или эмоции.

objectives: Summarise the main point of a short news report.
Distinguish reported information from the speaker’s opinion.
grammar_focus: Use reported speech with что and whether questions with ли.
Sequence past events with сначала, затем and после этого.
Use time expressions that identify when an event happened.

practice.reading: Write a short local news report with a quoted opinion. Ask which details are facts and who gave the opinion.
practice.writing: Summarise a short report and add a clearly separate opinion.
practice.translation: Translate a brief news account with source attribution.
practice.word_jumble: Build a sentence reporting a fact or someone’s statement.
practice.speaking: Discuss a local news item, clarify the source and explain your reaction.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Составьте предложение, в котором сообщается факт или передаются чьи-либо слова.

objectives: Agree on shared household tasks.
Explain a problem and a practical order of work.
grammar_focus: Contrast regular duties and finished tasks through aspect.
Use temporal clauses with перед тем как and после того как.
Use obligation and requests with нужно, должен and не мог бы.

practice.reading: Housemates divide tasks before guests arrive. Ask who does what and which tasks depend on others.
practice.writing: Write a practical message agreeing household responsibilities.
practice.translation: Translate instructions and polite requests for shared chores.
practice.word_jumble: Use household words to explain what needs doing and when.
practice.speaking: Agree how to divide household tasks and resolve a missed chore.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Объясните, какое домашнее дело нужно сделать и когда.

objectives: Make, change or decline an arrangement politely.
Explain a misunderstanding and suggest a resolution.
grammar_focus: Use reported requests with чтобы: попросил, чтобы я позвонил.
Use conditional suggestions with бы.
Choose aspect when making or changing plans.

practice.reading: A misunderstanding changes a meeting plan. Ask what each person understood and how they resolve it.
practice.writing: Write a polite message changing an arrangement and giving a reason.
practice.translation: Translate invitations, refusals and apologies with suitable politeness.
practice.word_jumble: Build a sentence proposing or explaining a change of plan.
practice.speaking: Reschedule a meeting while recognising the other person’s plans.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Предложите изменить планы или объясните, почему их нужно изменить.

objectives: Describe a historical place or cultural tradition.
Explain the order and simple significance of past events.
grammar_focus: Use dates and centuries in taught case patterns.
Use past tense and aspect to distinguish background from a completed event.
Use relative clauses to connect a person or place with its history.

practice.reading: Describe the history of a local building or tradition using clearly framed factual or fictional material. Ask about sequence and purpose.
practice.writing: Write a short account of a tradition or historical place.
practice.translation: Translate a connected historical description with dates and sequence.
practice.word_jumble: Use cultural vocabulary to connect an event with a place or period.
practice.speaking: Explain a familiar tradition to a visitor and answer follow-up questions.

practice_ru.word_jumble: Свяжите историческое событие с местом или периодом, используя предложенные слова.

objectives: Present a work proposal and justify priorities.
Negotiate responsibilities, deadlines or conditions.
grammar_focus: Use purpose, concession and condition clauses to explain trade-offs.
Use impersonal and passive constructions appropriate to work correspondence.
Distinguish process, completion and repeated obligation through aspect.

practice.reading: Two proposals compete for a limited budget and deadline. Ask about assumptions, trade-offs and the recommended choice.
practice.writing: Write a concise work proposal or a response negotiating a deadline.
practice.translation: Translate professional exchanges while preserving conditions and degree of commitment.

objectives: Compare approaches to learning and assessment.
Explain an academic goal using supporting reasons.
grammar_focus: Use relative and participial constructions to identify courses or research.
Express comparison and concession with тогда как and хотя.
Use abstract nouns with governed complements: требование к, подготовка к.
